why: The docs' WSGI transport example (docs/advanced/transports.md, "WSGI Transport" → `transport = httpx.WSGITransport(app=app)`, `with httpx.Client(transport=transport, base_url="http://testserver") as client: r = client.get("/")`, asserting `r.status_code == 200` and `r.text == "Hello World!"`) is the canonical first-shown usage that needs no network, and it exercises the full intended journey: request building/header merging in `Client`, dispatch through the transport, and response decoding into text.
